content_universe: Pixel & Ink Studio — Grammar emerges from authentic design-studio situations: introducing yourself to a client (Gr1 be + Gr2 pronouns), describing font/color/shape (Gr3 plurals+a/an, Gr4 adjective position), giving design instructions (Gr5 imperative).
derived_from: pm-2-3.json (Master Anchor Text — grammar backbone embedded)
pm-2-4.json (Writing task where Gr1-Gr4 are applied)

grammar_session_5_apply: Gr14 preposition IN (location — in the file, in the canvas)
pm0_anchor.feedback_mode_dominant: Guided discovery (PRE) + Explicit explanation (DURING) + Error analysis (POST)
success_factors_applied: Salience (target structures highlighted via color + underline + box)
Use (immediate productive use in mini-tasks per archetype)
Connection (each structure tied to a real Toolbelt noun/verb)
Emotion (playful competitions in Archetype C; personal sentences in D)
Spaced repetition (Gr1+Gr3 recycled from S2; Gr2+Gr4 re-practiced S4 and S5)
Synergy (Grammar mirrors Reading, Writing, Listening, Speaking structures)

universe_anchor.grammar_lives_in_context: Each grammar group is introduced through Pixel & Ink Studio utterances, NOT through isolated drill sentences.

Gr1_be: She is Sophia. (Pointing to AD in team photo)
The font is Playfair Display. (Design decision email)
The colors are warm. (Design decision email)
Gr2_pronouns_possessives_demonstratives: My client is La Esquina Bakery.
Your font choice is excellent. (Sophia to Andrés)
Gr3_plurals_a_an: A serif font. An email. The fonts are beautiful.
The brief has a logo, an icon, and two colors.
I open a canvas. I save a file. I send an email.
Gr4_adjective_position_pre_noun: A round seal. (not: a seal round)
A bold font. A cool palette. A simple logo.
Gr5_imperative: Don't use red for the bakery.
Gr14_preposition_IN: The logo is in the file.
The text is in the canvas.
Gr15_connectors_AND_BUT: Warm colors AND a serif font.
The logo is round BUT simple.

grammar_dosage_validation.pm0_92_rule: Max 2 Intro per session — PASS for both S3 and S5
grammar_dosage_validation.cognitive_load_note: S5 has 6 groups active but most are recycling/consolidating; only Gr5 is new.

bilingual_unified_header.english: GRAMMAR WORKSHOP — You already USE these structures. Now we make them visible.
bilingual_unified_header.spanish_italics: (Ya USAS estas estructuras. Ahora las hacemos visibles.)
bilingual_unified_header.motivational_hook: Grammar is NOT rules you memorize. It's patterns you already said today. Let's see them.

grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.name: Verb BE (am/is/are)
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.visual_summary: I am | You are | He/She/It is | We are | They are
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.A1_1_note: Contractions (I'm, She's, It's) introduced via Reading PM-2.3 — not drilled here.
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.common_error_A1_1: Omitting be: *I Andrés → I am Andrés.

grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.name: Pronouns + Possessives + Demonstratives
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.A1_1_note: Focus on I/you/she/it + my/your + this/these. Stretch: he/his + that/those.
studio_examples: My client is La Esquina Bakery.
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.common_error_A1_1: Confusing possessive 'your' with contraction 'you're': *Your welcome → You're welcome.

grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.name: Plurals + Articles a/an
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.formula: a + [consonant sound noun] | an + [vowel sound noun] | [noun]s for plurals
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.visual_summary: a font / an email / the fonts / a canvas / an icon / colors
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.A1_1_note: 'a/an' depends on SOUND, not letter. 'an hour' (silent h). 'a university' (y-sound).
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.common_error_A1_1: Using 'a' before vowel sound: *a email → an email.

grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.name: Adjective Position (pre-noun)
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.visual_summary: a WARM color ✓ | a color warm ✗ | a BOLD font ✓ | a font bold ✗
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.A1_1_note: English is OPPOSITE of Spanish: 'una FUENTE bold' in Spanish = 'a BOLD font' in English (adjective BEFORE noun).
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.common_error_A1_1: Spanish word order transfer: *colors warm → warm colors.

grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.name: Imperative (positive + negative)
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.visual_summary: Open the file. | Save it. | Don't use red. | Please check.
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.A1_1_note: No subject needed. 'Please' softens the command. 'Don't' = Do + not contracted.
studio_examples: Don't use red for the bakery.
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.common_error_A1_1: Adding subject: *You open the file → Open the file.

grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.name: Preposition IN (location)
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.visual_summary: in the file | in the canvas | in the cloud | in the folder
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.A1_1_note: 'IN' = inside something closed or bounded. Contrast with ON (surface) — not yet active.
studio_examples: The logo is in the file.
The text is in the canvas.
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.common_error_A1_1: Using Spanish preposition: *on the file (Sp: 'en el archivo').

grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.name: Connectors AND / BUT
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.A1_1_note: Simplest connectors first. SO/BECAUSE reserved for G2.
studio_examples: Warm colors AND a serif font.
The logo is round BUT simple.
grammar_targets_with_visual_summaries.common_error_A1_1: Using 'AND' when meaning is contrast: *round and simple (if emphasizing contrast, BUT is better).

archetypes_integrated.policy: ALL 5 archetypes A-E are documented with full PRE/DURING/POST. Instructor picks one flow for S3 grammar block and another for S5 grammar block (2 total flows across the RAP).
archetypes_integrated.spanish: (TODOS los 5 arquetipos están documentados. Instructor elige un flujo para S3 y otro para S5.)

archetype_A_discovery.name: Discovery / Consciousness-Raising (Inductive)
archetype_A_discovery.when_it_works: When learners have already encountered the structure in Reading (PM-2.3) or Writing (PM-2.4); makes pattern visible by exploration, not lecture.
archetype_A_discovery.fit_for_A1_1: High — leverages prior input; reduces passive lecture time.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Read these 10 sentences from the Toolbelt article. Underline every ADJECTIVE + NOUN pair. (*Lee estas 10 oraciones del artículo Toolbelt. Subraya cada par ADJETIVO + SUSTANTIVO.*)
sentences: The bakery is an old shop.
A round seal is his logo.
activities.discovery_question: What do you notice? Where is the adjective — BEFORE or AFTER the noun?

activities.instruction_bilingual: In pairs, complete the rule. (*En parejas, completa la regla.*)
activities.rule_discovery_frame: In English, the adjective goes _________ (before/after) the noun. Example from text: '_________ _________.'
activities.contrast_question: In Spanish, where does the adjective usually go? Is English the same or different?
activities.teacher_move: Elicit rule from students. Do NOT state the rule first. Write student-generated rule on board.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Write 3 sentences about your logo for La Esquina Bakery using the pattern. (*Escribe 3 oraciones sobre tu logo usando el patrón.*)
activities.gallery_check: Exchange with partner. Partner circles adjective-noun pairs and confirms order.

archetype_B_controlled_practice.name: Controlled Practice (Focus on Form)
archetype_B_controlled_practice.when_it_works: When learners need accuracy reps; when the structure is high-frequency and foundational (Gr1 be, Gr3 a/an).
archetype_B_controlled_practice.fit_for_A1_1: High — builds muscle memory; low cognitive demand.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Review the rule. Choose 'a' or 'an' based on SOUND. (*Revisa la regla. Elige 'a' o 'an' según el SONIDO.*)
model_examples: a UNIVERSITY (y-sound at start = consonant sound — tricky!)
an HOUR (silent h = vowel sound — tricky!)

activities.instruction_bilingual: Fill the gaps. Then transform each to plural. (*Llena los espacios. Luego transforma cada uno a plural.*)
activities.self_check: Correct your own with the key after 10 min. Score: ___/20.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Listen. Write what you hear. (*Escucha. Escribe lo que oyes.*)
dictation_sentences_5: The logo is a round seal.
The colors are brown and cream.
A bakery is an old shop.
activities.success_criterion: 4/5 correct = proceed. 3/5 or less = redo 5 gap-fills.

archetype_C_communicative_grammar_tasks.name: Communicative Grammar Tasks (Focus on Meaning WITH Form)
archetype_C_communicative_grammar_tasks.when_it_works: When grammar must serve communication; when the structure enables a real workplace interaction.
archetype_C_communicative_grammar_tasks.fit_for_A1_1: High — meaning-first keeps motivation high; form emerges from need.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Work in groups of 4. You are the Pixel & Ink Studio team meeting. Each person introduces themselves + their current client. (*Trabajen en grupos de 4. Cada persona se presenta + su cliente actual.*)
role_cards_universe_anchored: You are ANDRÉS. Your client is La Esquina Bakery.
You are SOPHIA. You are the Art Director. Your client this week is TechNova Startup.
You are LAURA. You are the Senior Manager. Your client is Hotel Santa Fe.
You are a NEW HIRE. Your client is Café Luna.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Complete the team roster. You must ask AND answer in English. (*Completa la lista del equipo. Pregunta Y responde en inglés.*)
activities.task_structure: Each person has partial info. Must ask 3 questions to complete chart.
question_frames_provided: Is your project bold or simple?

activities.instruction_bilingual: Present your team to the class in 30 seconds using full sentences. (*Presenta tu equipo a la clase en 30 segundos con oraciones completas.*)
activities.presentation_frame: This is Andrés. He is the Junior Designer. His client is La Esquina Bakery. This is Sophia. She is the Art Director...
activities.self_assessment: Did I use Gr1 (is/are) 6+ times? Did I use Gr2 (my/his/her) 4+ times?

archetype_D_creative_production.name: Creative Production (Grammar in Authentic Output)
archetype_D_creative_production.when_it_works: When learners need ownership of their output; when personal relevance boosts retention.
archetype_D_creative_production.fit_for_A1_1: High with scaffolding — personal content + visual support.

activities.phase: PRE — Choose a Personal Client (5 min)
activities.instruction_bilingual: Invent your own client. Name + business type. (*Inventa tu propio cliente. Nombre + tipo de negocio.*)
activities.frame: My client is _________. It is a _________ [type]. My client wants a _________ [adjective] design.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Create a Design Card for your client. Include 5 sentences using the target structures. (*Crea una Design Card para tu cliente. Incluye 5 oraciones usando las estructuras target.*)
design_card_required_sentences: 1. [Gr1 be + Gr2 possessive]: My client is _________.
2. [Gr3 a/an]: The logo is a / an _________.
3. [Gr4 adjective position]: The colors are _________ and _________.
activities.creative_element: Draw (or ASCII-sketch) the logo on the card; color-code the palette.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Post your card on the wall. Walk around. Vote for the MOST CREATIVE + GRAMMATICALLY STRONG card. (*Pega tu tarjeta en la pared. Recorran. Voten por la tarjeta más creativa y gramaticalmente fuerte.*)
activities.dual_criterion_evaluation: Star if creative + check if grammar is accurate. Must have both to win.

archetype_E_editing_error_analysis.name: Editing & Error Analysis (Focus on Form Post-Production)
archetype_E_editing_error_analysis.when_it_works: After productive skills (Writing, Speaking) when errors are visible; builds metalinguistic awareness.
archetype_E_editing_error_analysis.fit_for_A1_1: Stretch — requires analytical stance; works best AFTER Writing task (PM-2.4).
best_for_structures: All 7 active groups — integrative error hunt

activities.instruction_bilingual: Spot the error in each sentence. Circle + fix. (*Detecta el error. Circula + corrige.*)
sentences_with_errors: *The colors warm are beautiful. → Warm colors are beautiful.
*Andrés open a email. → Andrés opens an email.
*My client is a Laura. → My client is Laura. (no article with names)
*You open the file. (as instruction) → Open the file.
*The logo round simple is. → The logo is round AND simple.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Swap emails from PM-2.4 with a partner. Find 3 errors. Classify by grammar group. (*Intercambia emails de PM-2.4. Encuentra 3 errores. Clasifica por grupo gramatical.*)

error_taxonomy_chart.error_example: *You save the file → SAVE the file

activities.peer_dialogue_frame: I see [N] errors in your email. Error 1 is [group]. The sentence says '_____' but it should say '_____'.

reflection_prompts: The error I keep making is _________ (which grammar group?).
The strongest grammar in my email was _________.

rotation_options_for_instructor.policy: Grammar has TWO sessions (S3 and S5). Instructor picks a flow for each.
rotation_options_for_instructor.spanish: (Grammar tiene DOS sesiones. El instructor elige un flujo para cada una.)

flows_for_S3.name: Discovery-First S3 (Recommended A1.1 default)
flows_for_S3.sequence: Archetype A (Discovery) on Gr4 adjective position → Archetype B (Controlled) on Gr2 possessives → Applied in PM-2.4 Writing
flows_for_S3.best_for: Learners who learn by seeing patterns first
flows_for_S3.time: 25 min A + 25 min B = 50 min dedicated grammar (fits 1.0h direct)

flows_for_S3.name: Controlled-First S3
flows_for_S3.sequence: Archetype B (Controlled Practice) on Gr3 a/an + Gr4 → Archetype C (Communicative) team intros
flows_for_S3.best_for: Learners who need accuracy reps before communication

flows_for_S5.name: Imperative Mastery S5 (Recommended)
flows_for_S5.sequence: Archetype A (Discovery) on Gr5 imperative using design tutorials → Archetype D (Creative) produce design card
flows_for_S5.best_for: S5 focus is Language Functions integration

flows_for_S5.name: Editing-Focused S5
flows_for_S5.sequence: Archetype E (Editing & Error Analysis) on PM-2.4 emails → Archetype B (Controlled) on Gr5 imperative + Gr14 IN
flows_for_S5.best_for: When S4 writing exposed many errors; fixes before final evaluation

flows_for_S5.name: Maximalist Consolidation S5
flows_for_S5.sequence: Archetype C (Communicative) on Gr5 + Gr14 → Archetype D (Creative) design card with all 7 groups

rotation_options_for_instructor.recommended_default_for_G1: S3: FLOW-G3-1 (Discovery + Controlled). S5: FLOW-G5-1 (Discovery Imperative + Creative Card).

auditors_checklist.title: 📋 GRAMMAR AUDITOR'S CHECKLIST — Self-Check After Production
auditors_checklist.instruction_bilingual: After you write a sentence (in email, speaking, or workbook), check: (*Después de escribir una oración, verifica:*)

criteria.criterion: Gr1: Did I use AM/IS/ARE correctly?
Gr2: Is the demonstrative (this/that) and possessive (my/her) correct?
Gr3: Did I use a/an based on SOUND? Did I pluralize with -s?
Gr4: Is the adjective BEFORE the noun? (warm colors, not colors warm)
Gr5 (S5+): Is my instruction without 'You'? (Open, not You open)

rubric_visible_to_learner.title: 📊 VISIBLE RUBRIC — Grammar Contribution to E-Cuestionario S6 (5 pts)
rubric_visible_to_learner.instruction_bilingual: Grammar is evaluated in S6 Cuestionario Consolidado — 5 items × 1 pt each. (*La gramática se evalúa en S6 Cuestionario — 5 ítems × 1 pt cada uno.*)

tres_versiones.apropiacion_s3_s5: Grammar blocks integrated into S3 (Gr2, Gr4 intro) and S5 (Gr5 intro + consolidation of all)
tres_versiones.evaluacion_s6: 5 items in Grammar section of Cuestionario Consolidado (1 pt each, 5 pts total Grammar)
tres_versiones.autonomia_workbook: REINFORCE: gap-fills with Toolbelt nouns. EXTEND: write a tutorial using imperatives. PREPARE: observe grammar in listening audio for S4.

cuestionario_items_harvest_preview.note: Items generated here feed PM-4.2 Cuestionario S6 Grammar section (5 items × 1 pt).

sample_items.stem: ____ is the brief for Andrés's client.
Rewrite as instruction: 'You save the file.'
options: a) You are saving the file.

accuracy_techniques: Self-check key after Archetype B drills

stress_pronunciation_in_grammar.focus: Contractions (I'm, She's, It's) have reduced stress on 'm/s; full form (I am) has stress on both words.
stress_pronunciation_in_grammar.technique: Clap-clap on 'I AM' (two beats) vs clap on 'I'm' (one beat).

accuracy_techniques: Peer email audit with error taxonomy (Archetype E)
fluency_techniques: Team brief meetings using all groups (Archetype C)

stress_pronunciation_in_grammar.focus: Imperative verbs carry strong stress on first content word. 'OPEN the file' vs 'the FILE is open'.
stress_pronunciation_in_grammar.technique: Voice drop at end of imperative to signal instruction, not question.

Gr4 activates: warm, cool, bold, serif, sans-serif, simple, round, traditional

activities.statement: Identificar e inducir el patrón de 7 grupos gramaticales (Gr1 be, Gr2 pronouns/possessives/demos, Gr3 a/an/plurals, Gr4 adjective position, Gr5 imperative, Gr14 preposition IN, Gr15 connectors AND/BUT) a partir de utterances auténticas del universo Pixel & Ink Studio.

Aplicar las estructuras gramaticales en tareas comunicativas del mundo del diseño (presentar al equipo, describir decisiones, dar instrucciones de software) con mínimo 6 usos correctos por sesión de práctica.
Auditar textos propios y de pares (emails de PM-2.4) usando la taxonomía de errores de los 7 grupos gramaticales, clasificando y corrigiendo mínimo 3 errores por texto.
